verdict.rationale: Jules gets access to your repositories, clones the code into a VM, and creates PRs that you approve, merge and publish on GitHub. It also supports GitHub issue labels for assigning tasks, and the API's automationMode controls whether PRs are auto-created. Community users confirm good GitHub integration and usable PRs waiting for review. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the repo-connection/authorization flow itself (e.g., GitHub app install steps, per-repo permission scoping).
